titolo: NVIDIA details sparse‑attention design for faster long‑context inference
descr: NVIDIA published a technical blog on Nov 17, 2026 describing a co‑design approach for sparse attention on GPUs.
paragrafi: NVIDIA published a technical blog on Nov 17, 2026 describing a co‑design approach for sparse attention on GPUs.
Sparse attention limits each query to a small set of keys, moving most scoring work to an indexer that runs as a batched matrix multiply.
The indexer and Top‑k stages together account for 47% of the pre‑fill time in DeepSeek V3.2 when processing 128 K tokens.
Fusing Top‑k into the indexer kernel removes logit write‑back and reusing the previous selection speeds Top‑k by 2.1‑2.4×.
perche: For AI practitioners, the guidance helps build models that keep inference fast even with very long documents.
